confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or current menus. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is the least certain group. Sri Lanka's high import duties on alcohol push wine and cocktail prices well above beer, and the July 2026 rupee rate is uncertain. FX is the RBA 15 Oct 2026 AUD/USD figure as reported in a search summary; I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: South Asia basis, benchmarked against mid-priced tourist cities in India and Southeast Asia and adjusted upward for alcohol duties and the tourist-hotel premium in Colombo.
